images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create exactly ONE independent photorealistic rehabilitation exercise photograph, frame 159 / step s02, the MIDWAY posture of an UNLOADED RIGHT-arm diagonal raise, not a montage.
Reference images 1–3 are identity, clothing and photographic style references ONLY. Same Chinese adult woman, identical facial identity and age, natural proportions, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve T-shirt and charcoal full-length trousers; clean white trainers. Seamless grey-blue studio floor and backdrop, soft studio light and natural contact shadows, no text or arrows.
Camera: nearly frontal, very slightly from her right, fixed full-body portrait framing including complete head, both hands and both shoes with margins. She stands upright facing forward, feet hip-width and parallel, pelvis and breastbone square forward, no trunk twist, no arching.
Action: it is her anatomical RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT arm in the frontal view). The motion starts with this right hand in front of the opposite LEFT thigh and will finish diagonally up and out to her RIGHT front at below shoulder height. Show only the MIDPOINT now: her right hand is in the space in front of the middle of her abdomen, at approximately upper-waist / lower-sternum height, moving away from the opposite left thigh toward her right front. Right arm reaches forward in a low diagonal, elbow nearly straight but relaxed, wrist straight, fingers relaxed and clearly anatomically correct. Right hand is EMPTY. Left arm hangs relaxed beside her left hip. Shoulders remain level and relaxed, head looks forward. This midpoint must be substantially lower and closer to the body midline than the final raised arm. No ghosted limbs, no motion trails, no weights, no extra objects.
checks: 右手徒手位于腹部前方中途，低于终点、接近身体中线
左手自然下垂，双肩/躯干/骨盆朝前未扭转
头、双手、双足完整可见，比例自然、手指连续
衣着/身份/灰蓝背景与参考一致

images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate exactly ONE independent photorealistic rehabilitation exercise photograph: action 163 T-AXU-028, s01 START of a standing TWO-HANDED landmine bar press. The 3 reference images define the same Chinese adult woman's facial identity, age, black ponytail, white short-sleeve T-shirt, charcoal long trousers and soft gray-blue studio photographic style. Add clean white trainers.
Wide landscape composition, a fixed three-quarter SIDE-FRONT camera with a mostly side-on view of the exercise. Woman stands on the RIGHT side of image facing LEFT, full body visible with both complete shoes and both hands. Seamless gray-blue background/floor, soft light and natural shadows. No text, arrows, logos, collage or inset.
Equipment must be mechanically realistic: a straight rigid approximately 2-meter Olympic bar, one end securely captured in a visible purpose-made floor-mounted swiveling landmine socket on the LEFT of frame. Show the complete low heavy black steel rectangular landmine base with four visible mounting bolts and the pivoted cylindrical bar socket. The other free bar end rises diagonally up-right from that fixed pivot to her two hands in front of her upper chest / shoulder level. Full rod and both ends visible. No wall, improvised corner, floating bar, bent rod or extra bar. Use a light unloaded bar with a normal short thick free sleeve, no weight discs.
Pose: both feet planted hip-width in a stable parallel stance, knees softly unlocked, pelvis and ribcage upright without leaning back. Both hands clasp the SAME free bar sleeve end together close in front of upper chest at shoulder level, palms/fingers wrap around and support the end, both elbows bent and angled down. Keep her torso behind the grip, bar in front of body, no shaft through the body. Shoulders relaxed, neck neutral, gaze along the bar. It is the start frame before extending both arms forward and upward around the fixed pivot. Show clear hand grip, both elbow positions, ground contacts and dedicated base. Natural human limb proportions and anatomically correct hands.
checks: 站姿双手在肩前握同一杠端，肘弯曲下垂，双脚着地
专用带螺栓底座和转动套筒明确可见，杠杆连续不穿体
完整全身/整杆/支点可见，长度与身高比例合理
躯干稳定无后仰，人物/衣服/灰蓝背景一致
